_comment: Synthetic-only regression fixture copied from a verified /v1/systemone smoke exchange (live-smoke.json). It contains no credential, live transcript, or response metadata. Used to pin the real request/response wire shape: lowercase question/answer types, per-question instructions, choice criteria maps, and choice/noul answer fields (never value).
